Adjusted operating income: The Company defines adjusted operating income as operating income excluding depreciation and amortization.
The Company defines adjusted operating margin as adjusted operating income divided by revenue.
Free cash flow: The Company defines free cash flow as net cash provided by operating activities minus payments for capital additions.
